description: Wi-Fi access points: clients, traffic, how busy each channel is, signal, retries and device health. The table at the top compares every access point at a glance; the charts show how that changed over time.

panels.title: Access points
panels.description: Access points selected.

panels.title: Wi-Fi clients
panels.description: Devices connected over Wi-Fi now, staff and guests.

panels.title: Wi-Fi experience
panels.description: UniFi's satisfaction score for connected Wi-Fi devices, averaged over access points. Orange below 80%, red below 60%.

panels.title: Weak signal
panels.description: Wi-Fi devices with a signal below −75 dBm now. They're slow and drop often, usually because they're far from an access point.

panels.title: Busiest channel
panels.description: The highest channel use on any selected access point and band now. Above 60% clients start to feel slow; above 80% it's congested.

panels.title: Retries
panels.description: Share of Wi-Fi packets that had to be sent again, across selected access points (last 5 min). Above 15% points to interference or weak signal.

targets.expr: sum(rate(unpoller_device_vap_transmit_retries_total{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$AP"}[5m])) / (sum(rate(unpoller_device_vap_transmit_packets_total{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$AP"}[5m])) + sum(rate(unpoller_device_vap_transmit_retries_total{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$AP"}[5m])))

panels.title: Access points
panels.description: Every access point side by side. Channel use above 60% and retries above 15% are highlighted; average client signal below −75 dBm means devices are too far away or blocked by walls.

targets.expr: max by (name, model, version, ip) (unpoller_device_info{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$AP", type="uap"})

max by (name) (sum by (name) (rate(unpoller_device_vap_transmit_retries_total{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$AP"}[5m])) / (sum by (name) (rate(unpoller_device_vap_transmit_packets_total{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$AP"}[5m])) + sum by (name) (rate(unpoller_device_vap_transmit_retries_total{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$AP"}[5m]))))
max by (name) (sum by (name) (rate(unpoller_device_bytes_total{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$AP", type="uap"}[5m])) * 8)

panels.title: Clients per access point
panels.description: Connected Wi-Fi devices on each access point.

panels.title: Traffic per access point
panels.description: Wi-Fi traffic through each access point, both directions.

panels.title: 2.4 GHz channel use
panels.description: Share of time each access point's 2.4 GHz channel was busy, from its own and neighbouring traffic. Dashed line at 60%. 2.4 GHz reaches further but has only three usable channels, so it fills up first.

panels.title: 5 GHz channel use
panels.description: Share of time each access point's 5 GHz channel was busy, from its own and neighbouring traffic. Dashed line at 60%. 5 GHz is faster with more channels, but reaches less far through walls.

panels.title: Wi-Fi experience
panels.description: UniFi's satisfaction score for devices on each access point. Dashed line at 80%.

panels.title: Average client signal
panels.description: Average signal of the devices on each access point, in dBm (closer to 0 is stronger). Dashed line at −75 dBm; below it devices are slow and drop.

panels.title: Retries
panels.description: Share of Wi-Fi packets each access point had to send again. Dashed line at 15%.

targets.expr: sum by (name) (rate(unpoller_device_vap_transmit_retries_total{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$AP"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (name) (rate(unpoller_device_vap_transmit_packets_total{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$AP"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (name) (rate(unpoller_device_vap_transmit_retries_total{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$AP"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Clients by band
panels.description: How many devices use each band across the selected access points. More on 5 GHz is better.

panels.title: Clients per Wi-Fi network
panels.description: Devices on each Wi-Fi network (SSID) now, across selected access points.

panels.title: Wi-Fi networks by access point
panels.description: Each Wi-Fi network on each access point and band, with its devices and their experience.

targets.expr: sum by (name, essid, band) (unpoller_device_vap_satisfaction_stations{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$AP"})
avg by (name, essid, band) (unpoller_device_vap_satisfaction_ratio{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$AP"} >= 0)

panels.title: Channels and power
panels.description: Current channel and transmit power of each radio.

panels.title: Channel
panels.description: Channel each radio used over time. Frequent changes mean the access point keeps finding interference.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU use of each access point.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Memory use of each access point.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since each access point last started. A drop to zero is a restart.

panels.title: Drops and errors
panels.description: Wi-Fi packets dropped or received with errors, per access point. Should stay near zero.

targets.expr: sum by (name) (rate(unpoller_device_vap_receive_dropped_total{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$AP"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(unpoller_device_vap_transmit_dropped_total{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$AP"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(unpoller_device_vap_receive_errors_total{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$AP"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(unpoller_device_vap_transmit_errors_total{source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", name=~"$AP"}[$__rate_interval]))

title: UniFi Access Points
